content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know how to set minimum and maximum limits on an analog input field within [product_name] Web Editor, so that users cannot enter values outside the defined range?
This feature is not available in [product_name] Web Editor. You will need to implement the min/max checking logic within the [product_name] program itself.
Please see the attached example for reference.
Thank you, this solution works as expected.

analysis.insight_summary: Users highlighted that the current product lacks a built-in capability to restrict analog input fields to specified minimum and maximum values within the web editor. As a result, input validation must be handled within the main program, not directly in the editor.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the web editor to allow configuration of minimum and maximum limits directly on analog input fields, making it possible to block entry of values outside those specified bounds.
pain_keywords: lack of validation in web editor
